title: Change Order Form
oneLiner: Free change order form maker for small contractors: write the change on the phone, send the homeowner a sign-off link, keep the signed record
customer: Small US service businesses and contractors
revenueModel: Free single change order with PDF; paid tier for saved jobs, client sign-off links with a timestamped record and team use

evidence.claim: JustSignOff sells construction change order sign-off from USD 49 a month flat (free trial): customers approve, decline or ask for changes from a text or email link without an app, and approved orders become timestamped signed PDFs.

AddWork, an iPhone app for contractor estimates and change orders with no-login client approval by email or SMS, charges USD 9.99 a month after a 14-day trial, has 10 ratings averaging 4.6, and one reviewer says it already saved 10 times what it cost.
Joist puts sending change orders on its Elite plan at USD 24 a month billed monthly (list USD 32); its FAQ says the free plan is no longer available.
Fieldwire includes RFIs, submittals and change orders only from Business Plus at USD 89 a user a month; its free Basic plan has none of them.
Snappii Construction Change Order App sells a USD 15.99 a month or USD 159.99 a year subscription after a 14-day trial; its one visible review complains you cannot test it without paying.

Levelset hosts 16 pages of change order questions from contractors, including a remodeler with only emails and texts as proof whose owner will not pay for requested change order work, and a sub with USD 23,000 of extras unbilled 4 months waiting for written change orders.

ChangeSeal sells phone change orders that the homeowner signs on their own phone with no app and a signed PDF on file, on a 14-day trial, and cites a recurring ContractorTalk thread asking for a script to get change orders signed.

nextAction: Research writes the sceptical business case, Farhan sizes it, CEO decides go or no-go. Evidence against: the no-login homeowner sign-off link is already sold by JustSignOff, AddWork, ChangeSeal and SteelHand (https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/steelhand-contractor-estimates/id6802784970), so the gap is only that ours is free with no account; Reddit threads on unpaid unsigned extras could not be read (scraper blocked).

lead.name: Shaurya
lead.trait: Picks one metric and moves it.

paidPrice.product: Joist Elite at USD 24 a month billed monthly (list USD 32), the Joist plan that adds and sends change orders; no free plan. About Rs 2,263 at 94.2754 INR per USD

searches.note: DataForSEO Google Ads search volume (United States) through Firecrawl Alexandria, request 4908d495-cca6-4d96-82d7-3c3039db7ae2, read 2026-11-27. seodata.dev (cached 27 Sep 2026) shows construction change order 1,600 and change order 3,600 on the source page; change order alone is mixed with definition intent and is left out.

screen.freeGap: Free change order tools are downloads signed by hand: Housecall Pro gives an Excel or Google Sheets template behind a lead form with signature blocks (https://www.housecallpro.com/general-contractor/templates-calculators/free-change-order-template/), CountBricks a PDF with signature lines and e-sign only in its paid app after a 7-day trial (https://www.countbricks.com/post/free-change-order-forms-for-contractors). Paid tools sell the sign-off link: JustSignOff from USD 49 with no free plan (https://www.capterra.co.uk/software/1107866/JustSignOff), AddWork USD 9.99 a month after a 14-day trial (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/addwork/id6740415862), Fieldwire only on Business Plus at USD 89 a user (https://www.Fieldwire.Com/pricing/). The gap is a free change order with a homeowner approve link and a signed record, no account. Risk: Housecall Pro, Smartsheet, template.net and Jotform hold page one.
